proposal.quote: Chamberlain’s timely declaration (a) is aimed to serve as an interim commitment somewhat as if Britain had taken out a “binder” on Poland pending Beck’s London arrival to work out the details of a definite insurance policy
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The document reports Chamberlain's recent declaration as a commitment of support to Poland awaiting a definite agreement, which meets the threshold of the Prime Minister's public commitment to Poland, though reported second-hand by the ambassador.

proposal.quote: Britain and France have decided their front lines of defense east of Berlin lie not only at the Dardanelles ... but also definitely in Poland
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports a standing Anglo-French commitment to defend Poland, a third state Germany threatens, which is the resolved level, read from the ambassador's characterization of Chamberlain's declaration.

proposal.quote: that an Axis-imprisoned Rome was seeking friends outside or acting as Berlin’s agent towards inveigling Moscow into political conversations with Axis
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage states outright that Rome is bound in the Axis with Berlin, reporting the Rome-Berlin alignment as an existing state of affairs.

proposal.quote: while leaving door open to Rome’s possible change of heart, London and Paris may conceivably let Rome temporarily “stew in her own juice”
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports Rome as currently out of favor with London and Paris, needing a "change of heart", which is the estranged state, though it appears inside a speculative forecast.

proposal.quote: The armed absorption of Bohemia and Moravia
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports the armed absorption of Bohemia and Moravia, meaning German control of the region, which meets the german threshold for bohemia.

proposal.quote: Prime Minister Chamberlain’s pronouncement of March 30 [31], by which British power was related to the independence of Poland
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports Chamberlain's pronouncement of 31 March 1939 committing British power to Polish independence, which is the Polish guarantee.

proposal.quote: Prime Minister Chamberlain’s pronouncement of March 30 [31], by which British power was related to the independence of Poland
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The reported Chamberlain pronouncement is a standing commitment to support Poland against Germany, meeting the resolved threshold for commit_WEST.

proposal.quote: Germany, which has readmitted Austria into the fold
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage states Austria has been incorporated into Germany, matching the annexed level for austria.

proposal.quote: so long as the “axis” holds
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage treats the Rome-Berlin axis as an existing alignment in force, meeting the true threshold for axis.

proposal.quote: they have come to a reciprocal agreement: England fights for Poland and Poland fights for England
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports a standing Anglo-Polish commitment to fight for Poland, the substance of the guarantee the threshold rule records (the public statement being only its pending announcement).

proposal.quote: they have come to a reciprocal agreement: England fights for Poland and Poland fights for England
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports a standing British commitment to fight for a third state that Germany threatens, which is the resolved threshold.

proposal.quote: Chamberlain’s speech on the Polish situation ... Poland’s action in tying up with Great Britain
